description: Settings for scripts/candidate_digest.py. Queries and keyword patterns are the union of those used in the 2026-10-27 literature sweep. min_keyword_score 2 is the smallest threshold that met the 0.90 recall target in the 2026-10-28 backtest (recall 0.960; score 3 reached 0.879); records at detail_keyword_score or above are listed with an abstract snippet.
arxiv_query: abs:"single-cell" OR abs:"single cell" OR abs:"scRNA-seq" OR abs:"virtual cell" OR abs:"virtual cells" OR abs:"Perturb-seq" OR abs:"spatial transcriptomics" OR abs:"spatial transcriptomic" OR abs:"spatial omics" OR abs:"cell painting" OR abs:transcriptomic OR abs:transcriptomics OR abs:"perturbation response" OR abs:"cellular perturbation" OR abs:"gene perturbation" OR abs:"genetic perturbation" OR abs:"gene expression" OR abs:"cell morphology" OR abs:"spatial proteomics" OR abs:"multi-omics" OR abs:"gene regulatory network" OR abs:"CRISPR screen" OR abs:"drug response" OR abs:histopathology OR abs:"cell state" OR abs:CRISPR OR cat:q-bio.GN OR cat:q-bio.QM OR cat:q-bio.CB OR cat:q-bio.MN OR cat:q-bio.TO OR cat:q-bio.BM OR (abs:omics AND cat:cs.LG) OR (abs:perturbation AND abs:cell AND cat:cs.LG)
europepmc_query: (TITLE_ABS:"single-cell" OR TITLE_ABS:"single cell" OR TITLE_ABS:"scRNA-seq" OR TITLE_ABS:"spatial transcriptomics" OR TITLE_ABS:"spatial transcriptomic" OR TITLE_ABS:"spatial omics" OR TITLE_ABS:"spatial proteomics" OR TITLE_ABS:"cell painting" OR TITLE_ABS:"virtual cell" OR TITLE_ABS:"Perturb-seq" OR TITLE_ABS:"perturbation" OR TITLE_ABS:"transcriptomic" OR TITLE_ABS:"cell morphology" OR TITLE_ABS:"CRISPR screen") AND (TITLE_ABS:"deep learning" OR TITLE_ABS:"machine learning" OR TITLE_ABS:"foundation model" OR TITLE_ABS:"transformer" OR TITLE_ABS:"generative" OR TITLE_ABS:"neural network" OR TITLE_ABS:"artificial intelligence" OR TITLE_ABS:"language model" OR TITLE_ABS:"benchmark" OR TITLE_ABS:"diffusion model" OR TITLE_ABS:"representation learning" OR TITLE_ABS:"self-supervised" OR TITLE_ABS:"in silico" OR TITLE_ABS:"agent")
